description: Flood Reporting Noted by Toronto Water Districts is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. This dataset is no longer being maintained. Please see Basement Flooding by Ward for the latest update. Flooding calls received by Toronto Water District Operations. A Service Request is created based on the phone calls 311 and the location is investigated. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are basement flood, floods, sewer blockage, storm. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2023-03-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
